note: Trigg County (21221) parcels are not published as a public queryable service. The county PVA parcel viewer is hosted on qPublic (Schneider), which returns 403/Cloudflare to automated access and exposes no documented REST endpoint. Kentucky's state server (kygisserver) has PVA parcel services only for Webster County; no Trigg service exists (probe of Ky_PVA_Trigg_Parcels_WGS84WM returned not found). Trigg parcels are sold only by commercial vendors (Dynamo Spatial, ReportAllUSA, Regrid), and the acres/acrevalue plat viewers expose no public service. The KYTC PVA availability layer does not list Trigg as published.
